primary_sources.title: Aharonov–Bergmann–Lebowitz 1964
primary_sources.read_scope: Publisher abstract and existing project R083; finite-instrument formula and |+x>/Z example checked algebraically.

primary_sources.title: Tumulka 2006
primary_sources.read_scope: Abstract and introduction, explicit non-interacting-particle restriction. Counterexample to universal foliation/no-collapse claim; not adoption of GRW dynamics.

primary_sources.title: Klein–Randles 2011
primary_sources.read_scope: Introduction and section 5, equations 82–84; cosmic versus Fermi slices and flat Milne counterexample. No use of full global-chart theorem beyond its stated scope.

primary_sources.title: Fletcher 2024/2025
primary_sources.read_scope: Publication metadata; cosmic-time and causality discussion, footnote 30. Online 2024-11-26, print 2025-01-16.

primary_sources.title: Viglione 2026
primary_sources.read_scope: Abstract and introduction: argument conditional on Causal Connection Condition. Not a physical prohibition of all foliations.

primary_sources.read_scope: Original paper pp.297–298, Proposition 2, precise nontriviality and causal-automorphism conditions.
